"import csv
from docx import Document

# Read the CSV file
with open('load_01.csv', 'r', newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    rows = list(reader)

# Identify column indices
case_idx = header.index('case')
load_idx = header.index('load_factor')
cycles_idx = header.index('cycles')

# Compute statistics from the data
loads = [float(row[load_idx]) for row in rows]
cycles_vals = [int(row[cycles_idx]) for row in rows]

n_cases = len(rows)
load_max = max(loads)
load_mean = sum(loads) / n_cases
total_cycles = sum(cycles_vals)

# Format rounded display values
load_max_str = f"{round(load_max, 2):.2f}"
load_mean_str = f"{round(load_mean, 1):.1f}"

# Build the document
doc = Document()

# Title (as a heading)
doc.add_heading('Engineering Test Report', level=0)

# Overview
doc.add_heading('Overview', level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f'This report presents the analysis of {n_cases} data records '
    f'from the engineering test data file load_01.csv.'
)

# Results table
doc.add_heading('Results table', level=1)
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=3)
table.style = 'Table Grid'

# Header row
hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells
hdr_cells[0].text = 'case'
hdr_cells[1].text = 'load_factor'
hdr_cells[2].text = 'cycles'

# Data rows, preserving source values/formats
for row in rows:
    cells = table.add_row().cells
    cells[0].text = row[case_idx]
    cells[1].text = row[load_idx]
    cells[2].text = row[cycles_idx]

# Summary
doc.add_heading('Summary', level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(f'N cases = {n_cases}')
doc.add_paragraph(f'load max = {load_max_str}')
doc.add_paragraph(f'load mean = {load_mean_str}')
doc.add_paragraph(f'total cycles = {total_cycles}')

# Conclusion
doc.add_heading('Conclusion', level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    'All data records from the source file have been tabulated and the key '
    'statistics have been computed and reported above. The summary values provide '
    'a concise overview of the load conditions and cycle counts observed across '
    'the full set of test cases.'
)

# Save the document
doc.save('report.docx')"
